text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah... To think this happened...
Me... winning the Derby...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
this isn't a dream, right?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Just in case it's a dream, could you give my cheek
a nice, firm pinch?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's true.
All our fans are watching, after all~

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Still, what kind of trick did you use?
I was in no condition to win."
choice_data_list: I just did the best I could, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"All you did was work hard...
To think you could win with just that..."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you might be a far more amazing
person than I ever thought.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: There, there... Today, maybe you ended up pushing way past that limit.
choice_data_list: Does that mean I'm not a good girl?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes, words like that don't even begin to cover it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: May I praise you with the greatest words I can think of?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Here we go~. Everyone in the audience,
join in with me~. Ready, and...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, child of God, child of God~♪

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Child of God! Child of God—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A massive chorus echoes all around.
It seems an achievement of truly monumental proportions has been accomplished.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on your miraculous
Derby victory, Super Creek!
